Title: Public preview: Cross-account container copy for Azure Cosmos DB NoSQL API

Body.Content:
We are pleased to announce that the preview of cross-account container copy functionality is now available for NoSQL API in Azure Cosmos DB. With this feature, you can seamlessly migrate data from one container to another across different Azure Cosmos DB accounts in offline mode. This includes the ability to migrate data between serverless and provisioned accounts.
 
Using Azure CLI commands, you have the flexibility to effortlessly create and manage container copy jobs according to your schedule and requirements. What's even better is that there are no additional charges associated with migration.
 
Leverage this robust new capability to simplify your data migration process and enhance your workflow with Azure Cosmos DB. We encourage you to try it today and discover the advantages of streamlined and cost-effective container copy management.

Learn more.
